title: KachSMP Inferno
description: A modpack for KachSMP that aims to be vanilla like whilst still being fun
body:
This is a modpack made for the KachSMP server and its members for ease of use and updating

the modpack aims to keep the vanilla aesthetic while still adding alot of fun mods

there is a huge focus on exploration and decoration

(you will need to allocate more memory for the modpack to run)
